guidance.heading: TPU, NBR or PVC?
guidance.body: TPU is the strongest choice: extruded through the jacket in one pass, it carries the highest pressures (up to 85 bar on concrete hose), resists abrasion when dragged and comes in the longest lengths. NBR (nitrile rubber) resists oil and fuel residue and is rated 10 bar in every size — a good all-round dewatering and discharge hose. PVC is the light, low-cost option for clean water at low pressure. Lay flat hose collapses under vacuum, so pump suction needs a rigid-helix suction hose.

items.a: A hose with a woven textile jacket and a polymer tube and cover that flattens when empty. It rolls onto a reel, deploys in long continuous lengths and takes far less space than round hose or pipe.

items.q: Can lay flat hose be used on pump suction?
items.a: No. It collapses under vacuum. Use a rigid-helix suction hose on the inlet and lay flat on the discharge.
Yes. We cut to length and fit Bauer, camlock, Storz, grooved or flanged couplings, banded or with expansion-ring fittings sized to the hose.

items.q: How do I size a lay flat line?
items.a: Choose the bore for the flow and allowable friction loss over the line length, then check that the hose's working pressure at that bore covers the pump's maximum pressure plus surge. Send us the flow, length and pump and we will size it.

products.title: TPU Lay Flat Well Riser Hose
products.focusKeyword: tpu lay flat well riser hose
products.descriptionShort: Lay flat TPU riser main for submersible borehole pumps: 1-1/4" to 10", working pressure 18 to 40 bar by size, tensile strength up to 60,900 kg. Supplied in long continuous lengths or as made-up assemblies with couplings fitted, from Indus Hydraulics in the UAE.
products.descriptionLong:
A flexible riser main for submersible pumps in boreholes and deep wells. The hose replaces rigid steel or uPVC drop pipe: it is lowered straight off a reel, carries the pump and the water column on its own tensile strength, and comes out again the same way for pump service. TPU does not corrode or scale, so it suits acidic or aggressive groundwater where steel column pipe pits and blocks.

Construction

  • Tube and cover: TPU, extruded through the jacket in one pass, so the layers cannot separate
  • Reinforcement: circular-woven high-tenacity polyester
  • Temperature: -50 °C to +80 °C
  • Colour: blue

Why lay flat in a well

  • One continuous length up to 400 m — no threaded joints to leak or loosen
  • Tensile strength up to 60,900 kg holds the pump and the full water column
  • Smooth TPU bore resists scaling and debris build-up
  • Installed and recovered with a hose reel or winding unit rather than a pipe-handling rig

Pressure and sizes

Working pressure runs from 40 bar at 1-1/4" to 18 bar at 10", with burst at 2.1 to 2.5 times working pressure. Size the hose on the pump's shut-off head plus any surge, not on duty head. The Sizes & Part Numbers tab lists bore, wall, weight, pressure and tensile strength for each of the 10 sizes.

Fittings

Riser hose is joined to the pump and the well head with dedicated stainless couplings that clamp onto the hose and carry the tensile load. We supply the couplings matched to the bore.

Installation and care

  • Unroll the hose fully and lay it out straight before pressurising; a hose pressurised on the reel or with twists can kink and burst.
  • Run it along the shortest practical route, away from sharp edges and hot surfaces, and protect it with hose ramps where vehicles cross.
  • Raise and lower pressure gradually. Closing a valve suddenly on a long line causes a surge that can exceed the working pressure.
  • Stay within the working pressure of the size in use; burst pressure is a test figure, never an operating limit.
  • After use, drain the hose, flush it if it carried slurry, fuel or concrete, and roll it flat from the far end to push out what is left.
  • Store coils out of direct sunlight and away from sharp objects, and inspect the cover and coupling bands before each deployment.

How to order

Quote the Indus part number, or send the bore, the length you need, the fluid and the end connections. We supply bulk coils or made-up assemblies with couplings fitted and banded. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.

products.descriptionShort: Forestry and wildland fire hose with a natural rubber liner and a water-based polyurethane coating on the jacket for extra abrasion resistance: light, flexible and kink-resistant. Coupled, banded and tested to order by Indus Hydraulics in the UAE.
products.descriptionLong:
A forestry and wildland fire hose with a protective coating. A water-based polyurethane coat over the woven jacket takes the abrasion of being dragged over rock, roots and scrub, so the hose lasts longer than an uncoated forestry hose while staying light and flexible enough to carry and lay out quickly.

Construction

  • Liner: natural rubber (NR)
  • Reinforcement: single woven polyester jacket
  • Outer coating: water-based polyurethane for abrasion resistance
  • Colour: yellow

Where it fits

  • Wildland fire crews working rocky or abrasive terrain
  • Long progressive lays from portable pumps
  • Sites that wear out uncoated forestry hose quickly

Care and testing

  • Lay the hose out without kinks before charging it, and open the hydrant or pump valve slowly to avoid pressure surge.
  • Keep it away from hot surfaces, sharp edges and dragged loads; use hose bridges where vehicles cross.
  • After use, drain it, wash off oil, foam concentrate and mud, and let the jacket dry before it is rolled or racked.
  • Store it out of direct sunlight, away from chemicals and in a dry place, rolled or flaked as your equipment requires.
  • Inspect the jacket, liner and coupling bands before use, and service-test hoses at the interval your fire code sets — annually is common practice.

How to order

Send the bore, the length per hose (fire hose is usually supplied in 15, 20, 25 or 30 m lengths), the couplings and the standard your site, insurer or authority requires. We confirm construction, pressure rating and compliance before quoting, and supply hoses coupled, banded and pressure tested on request.

products.descriptionShort: Large-bore lay flat hose coupling with a grooved (Victaulic-type) end, for joining 4" to 16" lay flat hose to grooved pipe, pumps and manifolds: forged shank, re-attachable clamp, aluminium or stainless. Supplied loose or fitted to lay flat hose assemblies by Indus Hydraulics in the UAE.
products.descriptionLong:
A large-bore coupling that turns the end of a lay flat hose into a grooved pipe end, so the hose connects to grooved steel or HDPE pipe, pumps, valves and manifolds with a standard grooved clamp. It is the usual way to join 8" to 16" dewatering, frac water and transfer lines, where threaded couplings are too heavy and slow.

Construction

  • Hose shank: forged, for strength at large bores
  • Clamp: re-attachable bolted halves, so the coupling can be refitted to a new hose end
  • Finish: hard anodised for wear and corrosion protection (aluminium)
  • Materials: aluminium or stainless steel
  • Sizes: DN100 to DN400 (4" to 16")

Applications

  • Mine and construction dewatering lines
  • Frac water and temporary transfer pipelines
  • Agricultural and municipal large-bore water transfer

Fitting large-bore lay flat couplings

  • Cut the hose square and push it fully onto the shank before closing the clamp halves.
  • Tighten the clamp bolts evenly, side to side, to the torque given for the size; re-check after the first pressurisation.
  • Match the coupling to the hose: lay flat wall thickness varies by class, and a clamp sized for one wall will not hold another.
  • Check the working pressure of both the hose and the coupling — the line is limited by the lower of the two.
  • Inspect shanks, clamps and seals for damage before each deployment, and keep seals clean of grit.

How to order

Send the hose bore and type, the mating connection at the other end (Storz size, grooved pipe OD, flange standard and rating, or the mating half) and the working pressure. We supply couplings loose or fitted to the hose as assemblies. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.

products.descriptionLong:
The coupling for our TPU lay flat well riser hose. It joins the riser to the submersible pump outlet and to the well-head discharge, and carries the weight of the pump and water column through the hose. Stainless steel suits long submerged service in aggressive groundwater.
